decision_description: Constitutional violation §13.3 detected in docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json during constitutional compliance check (report: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/validation_reports/constitutional-compliance-check_4acdc86e.json). Specific project-fact names — 'Dr. András Jung' and 'Eötvös Loránd University, ELTE' — appear in partner_coverage_results[1] (partner_id: SUPERVISOR) and partner_coverage_results[2] (partner_id: HOST) budget_line_reference fields without a Tier 3 source citation in the artifact. The artifact's documented sources (interface_contract.json, wp_structure.json run_id 50ec7164-9a7e-419f-9db2-7b540e077f36, unit_cost_budget.json run_id 4acdc86e-4a04-4d55-b9f9-a04c9cd9e28e) are all Tier 4 or integration-layer artifacts; none are paths within docs/tier3_project_instantiation/. No traceability_footer.primary_sources field is present in the artifact providing a Tier 3 path reference for these project-specific names. Human operator must verify that these names are present in Tier 3 project instantiation data (expected: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json and docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/roles.json) and, if confirmed, amend budget_gate_assessment.json to include a direct Tier 3 source reference in the assessment_note sources list or a traceability_note field. If the names are not traceable to Tier 3, the artifact must be revised to remove or replace the untraced project-fact names before the artifact may be considered fully constitutionally compliant.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §13.3 — prohibition on inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3 project instantiation data (docs/tier3_project_instantiation/); all project-specific claims in phase outputs must be traceable to a named Tier 3 source per CLAUDE.md §10.5 and §12.1
rationale: The constitutional compliance check skill (report: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/validation_reports/constitutional-compliance-check_4acdc86e.json, prohibition_id: 13.3, check_status: violation, severity: critical) identified that budget_gate_assessment.json embeds the specific project-fact names 'Dr. András Jung' (SUPERVISOR identity) and 'Eötvös Loránd University, ELTE' (HOST legal name) in free-text budget_line_reference fields of partner_coverage_results. These facts are project-specific and must be traceable to Tier 3 under CLAUDE.md §13.3. The artifact's source list in assessment_note covers interface_contract.json (integration layer), wp_structure.json (Tier 4 phase output), and unit_cost_budget.json (Tier 4 phase output) — none of which are Tier 3 paths. The conservative application rule applied in the compliance check is correct: when applicability is uncertain, §13.3 must be assumed to apply. The violation is logged as unresolved because resolution requires human operator action: either (a) confirm the names appear in docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json and docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/roles.json and amend the artifact to cite those Tier 3 paths, or (b) revise the artifact to replace the named project facts with role-token references (SUPERVISOR, HOST) without embedded identity strings. This decision log entry is the durable record of the unresolved violation per CLAUDE.md §9.4 and §12.3; the decision may not be held only in agent memory.
